request.description:
This endpoint sends an HTTP GET request to shuffle the deck of cards with the specified deck ID, while also providing the option to include the remaining cards in the response.

### Request

- Method: GET
    
- URL: `https://deckofcardsapi.com/api/deck/:deckId/shuffle?remaining=true`
    
- Path Variable:
    
    - `deckId` (string, required): The ID of the deck to be shuffled.
        
- Query Parameter:
    
    - `remaining` (boolean, optional): Indicates whether to include the count of remaining cards in the response.
        

### Response

- Status: 200
    
- Content-Type: application/json
    
- { "success": true, "deck_id": "", "remaining": 0, "shuffled": true}
    

The response includes the following key-value pairs:

- `success` (boolean): Indicates the success status of the shuffle operation.
    
- `deck_id` (string): The ID of the shuffled deck.
    
- `remaining` (number): The count of remaining cards in the shuffled deck.
    
- `shuffled` (boolean): Indicates whether the deck has been shuffled.
